f1.assertion: Each used prediction is bound to the original fixed forecast version; preserve forecast_origin and available_at, and reject retrospective backfill as the original prediction.
f1.reject_if: Any output substitutes a forecast that was only available after its declared forecast origin, or omits its source version/time.

f1.assertion: Every selected actual label version has available_at no later than its decision origin under the declared allowed policy; retain revision and arrival time.
f1.reject_if: Any later-arriving version is used early or the declared policy cannot reproduce the selected version.

f1.assertion: Only include a target date when every coordinate from the locked series.csv exists for that origin and policy; exact retransmission does not create another coordinate.
f1.reject_if: A partial vector is padded, an exact retransmission is counted as a new coordinate, or the output silently removes a required series.

f1.assertion: Recompute residual as selected actual minus original fixed prediction in units 件; preserve per-coordinate source and times.
f1.reject_if: Any value differs, uses the revised/backfilled prediction, or omits units/lineage.

f1.assertion: If the declared lawful policy yields no complete vector, explain the maturity/availability reason and do not report a fabricated risk estimate.
f1.reject_if: An empty pool is silently treated as a zero-risk or another unsupported estimate.

f2.assertion: Run the frozen actual entrypoint from source inputs to current deliverable outputs and independently compare the results and semantics to reconstruct_raw.py.
f2.reject_if: Only a helper, screenshot, static description, exit code, or author pass statement is offered.

f2.assertion: Run one lawful consumer control that exercises an allowed source/time/completeness condition; verify the actual consumer output.
f2.reject_if: Control is only described or consumer does not produce the source-consistent behavior.

f2.assertion: Run one controlled invalid input/output that activates a frozen time, source, or completeness boundary; verify actual rejection or exclusion behavior.
f2.reject_if: Control is only static, fails to activate the selected condition, or consumer silently accepts a violating complete vector.

f2.assertion: Compare machine results with the Chinese note and verify units, decision origins, policy, constraints, and limitations agree.
f2.reject_if: Any material difference or unsupported interpretation.

five_source_time_assertion_classes: original forecast origin and forecast availability
selected label revision and declared version policy
full vector completeness and duplicate retransmission handling
residual definition, units, and source lineage
f3.assertion: For each class, cite the raw source, inspect the frozen artifact and actual check, state the verdict and limit; freeze artifact identities and retain complete terminal call records.
f3.reject_if: Any class lacks raw-source binding or performed check; call records omit a terminal state; producer self-check is presented as independent acceptance; actual provider/model/tokens/cost are guessed instead of recorded as null when unmeasured.

vector_count_rule: No fixed minimum or maximum vector count beyond the declared lawful policy and source completeness rules.

control_design_pending_actual_interface.lawful: Use an allowed complete source vector or exact duplicate retransmission fixture, preserving version and arrival lineage; consumer must remain source-consistent and avoid counting a retransmission twice.
control_design_pending_actual_interface.invalid: Use an isolated test fixture with a coordinate's available_at shifted past the selected decision origin and a fixture-specific integrity lock; consumer must reject it or exclude the vector as incomplete. Never modify frozen inputs or production artifacts.
